accepted_media_manifest_primitive: using System; using System.IO; using System.Text; using System.Runtime.InteropServices; using System.Security.Cryptography; using Microsoft.Win32.SafeHandles;
const uint FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES=0x80, GENERIC_READ=0x80000000, SHARE_READ=1, OPEN_EXISTING=3, BACKUP=0x02000000, OPEN_REPARSE=0x00200000, SEQUENTIAL=0x08000000, NO_RECALL=0x00100000;
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct BASIC { public long CreationTime,LastAccessTime,LastWriteTime,ChangeTime; public uint Attributes; }
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct STANDARD { public long AllocationSize,EndOfFile; public uint Links; public byte DeletePending,Directory; }
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct TAG { public uint Attributes,ReparseTag; }
[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)] public struct ID { public ulong VolumeSerial; [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.ByValArray,SizeConst=16)] public byte[] FileId; }

public sealed class SNAP { public string FinalPath,Identity; public long CreationTime,LastAccessTime,LastWriteTime,ChangeTime,AllocationSize,EndOfFile; public uint Attributes,Tag,CloudState,Links; public bool DeletePending,Directory; }
public sealed class READ { public long Length; public string Sha256; }
[DllImport("kernel32.dll",CharSet=CharSet.Unicode,SetLastError=true)] static extern SafeFileHandle CreateFileW(string p,uint a,uint s,IntPtr x,uint d,uint f,IntPtr t);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll",EntryPoint="GetFileInformationByHandleEx",SetLastError=true)] static extern bool GetBasic(SafeFileHandle h,int c,out BASIC v,uint z);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll",EntryPoint="GetFileInformationByHandleEx",SetLastError=true)] static extern bool GetStandard(SafeFileHandle h,int c,out STANDARD v,uint z);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll",EntryPoint="GetFileInformationByHandleEx",SetLastError=true)] static extern bool GetTag(SafeFileHandle h,int c,out TAG v,uint z);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll",EntryPoint="GetFileInformationByHandleEx",SetLastError=true)] static extern bool GetId(SafeFileHandle h,int c,out ID v,uint z);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll",CharSet=CharSet.Unicode,SetLastError=true)] static extern uint GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(SafeFileHandle h,StringBuilder b,uint n,uint f);
[DllImport("kernel32.dll",SetLastError=true)] static extern bool ReadFile(SafeFileHandle h,byte[] b,uint n,out uint r,IntPtr o);

public static SafeFileHandle Meta(string p,bool rp){var h=CreateFileW(p,FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES,7,IntPtr.Zero,OPEN_EXISTING,BACKUP|(rp?OPEN_REPARSE:0),IntPtr.Zero);if(h.IsInvalid)throw E("metadata open");return h;}
public static SafeFileHandle Data(string p){var h=CreateFileW(p,GENERIC_READ,SHARE_READ,IntPtr.Zero,OPEN_EXISTING,SEQUENTIAL|NO_RECALL,IntPtr.Zero);if(h.IsInvalid)throw E("data open");return h;}

public static SNAP Snap(SafeFileHandle h){BASIC b;STANDARD s;TAG t;ID i;if(!GetBasic(h,0,out b,(uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(BASIC)))||!GetStandard(h,1,out s,(uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(STANDARD)))||!GetTag(h,9,out t,(uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(TAG)))||!GetId(h,18,out i,(uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(ID))))throw E("metadata query");var q=new StringBuilder(32768);if(GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(h,q,(uint)q.Capacity,0)==0)throw E("final path");return new SNAP{FinalPath=q.ToString(),Identity=i.VolumeSerial.ToString("x16")+":"+BitConverter.ToString(i.FileId).Replace("-","").ToLowerInvariant(),CreationTime=b.CreationTime,LastAccessTime=b.LastAccessTime,LastWriteTime=b.LastWriteTime,ChangeTime=b.ChangeTime,Attributes=b.Attributes,Tag=t.ReparseTag,CloudState=CfGetPlaceholderStateFromAttributeTag(t.Attributes,t.ReparseTag),AllocationSize=s.AllocationSize,EndOfFile=s.EndOfFile,Links=s.Links,DeletePending=s.DeletePending!=0,Directory=s.Directory!=0};}
public static bool AllowedTag(SNAP s){bool r=(s.Attributes&0x400)!=0;if(!r)return s.Tag==0;return (s.Tag&0x20000000)==0&&(s.Tag&~0x0000f000u)==0x9000001au;}

public static READ Hash(SafeFileHandle h){var a=SHA256.Create();try{var b=new byte[1048576];long n=0;while(true){uint r;if(!ReadFile(h,b,(uint)b.Length,out r,IntPtr.Zero))throw E("raw read");if(r==0)break;a.TransformBlock(b,0,(int)r,null,0);n+=r;}a.TransformFinalBlock(new byte[0],0,0);return new READ{Length=n,Sha256=BitConverter.ToString(a.Hash).Replace("-","").ToLowerInvariant()};}finally{a.Dispose();}}
